fusions.name: Buried Charge
fusions.desc: Primes up to 3 bodies within 9 tiles for 30 seconds; each bursts for 30 damage the moment an enemy comes near, hitting enemies within 3.5 tiles for 80% of it.

fusions.name: Spoil Throw
fusions.desc: Fires a round that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gone Underground
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Dug Foothold
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a dodge that failed is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
